How to launch:

1. Check the system requirements.
System Requirements:
At a minimum, Windows 10 x64 (version 1909 or later) with Microsoft Store, Xbox, and Xbox Gaming Services installed.


2. Run GDK_Helper.bat located in the game folder. (Perform this step once)

3. Enable Developer Mode. (Restart your PC if prompted) (Perform this step once)
Before enabling Developer Mode, please look up what it is online.

4. Install the game. (Perform this step once)

5. Disable Developer Mode. (Perform this step once)

6. Launch the game via the Start menu.
